collectibles.name: A wax milk token
collectibles.description: A tiny wax seal stamped with a crescent and the words 'one warm glass, whenever you need it.'

collectibles.name: A blue coat button
collectibles.description: A smooth blue button caught beneath a curled corner of the town map. Someone in the faded street sketch is missing one from their coat.

collectibles.name: A silver-tipped feather
collectibles.description: A feather caught between the shrine roots, so light it barely rests in your palm. Its pale tip catches the moon without shining by itself.

collectibles.name: A piece of sea glass
collectibles.description: A small green shard, softened smooth by years of tide and carried here on a night with no wind.

collectibles.name: A brass lens screw
collectibles.description: A carefully polished screw from the old lens housing. The worn slot still fits a keeper's screwdriver.

collectibles.name: An unclaimed paper ticket
collectibles.description: A ticket with no destination and no date. The name line has been left blank on purpose.

collectibles.name: A chewed delivery tag
collectibles.description: A cardboard tag softened by small teeth. Under the tooth marks, someone has written 'rear door, knock twice, and mind the cat.'

collectibles.name: A glass memory bead
collectibles.description: A bead of clouded glass that hums faintly when held. Inside, a small birthday candle burns without ever getting shorter.

collectibles.name: A pressed moonflower petal
collectibles.description: A petal flattened between two cards and forgotten under the seat cushion. It still smells faintly of rain and warm honey.

collectibles.name: A pencilled bookmark
collectibles.description: A strip of card with a single question written in pencil: 'Who finishes the story when the reader falls asleep?'

collectibles.name: A seed warm to the touch
collectibles.description: A small dark seed that stays warm in a cold hand. It twitches, very slightly, whenever someone says its name wrong.
